_comment: CURATED, HAND-TRANSCRIBED public figures that have no data file behind them.
This file is the source of truth and lives on `main`; cited_figures_verify.py
copies it to construction_json/programs.json and checks every figure below
still appears verbatim on its live source page.
WHY VERIFY RATHER THAN SCRAPE: NRCan's provincial blocks carry each province's
NAME AFTER its figures in document order, so a positional parser pairs them off
by one and silently mis-assigns every province. A verifier that asserts known
values still appear cannot make that mistake, and it fails loudly on an update.
NOT INCLUDED, deliberately: any CaGBC LEED or Zero Carbon count. CaGBC publishes
no running total on its public pages and its project database is behind a
sign-in, so there is no figure here that could be verified the way the two
below are. Getting one means asking CaGBC, not guessing.
chba_hmi: transcribed from CHBA's own quarterly narrative text (the
'Key Findings' accordion on the HMI page), NOT from that page's chart
images. The charts are static PNG/JPG with no underlying data file, and
their auto-generated alt text was checked and found unreliable on
2026-08-31 -- one bar chart's alt text swapped which selling-condition
category (Good vs Fair) a percentage belonged to, and a line chart's alt
text mislabelled a quarter. The prose sentences are self-consistent
across all 21 quarters checked and are the only source used here.
Regional (Ontario/BC/Prairies/Atlantic) scores are included only from
2024 Q2 onward -- CHBA reported them as qualitative description only
before that quarter, not as index scores, so earlier quarters have no
regional figure to transcribe. Quebec and the territories have no CHBA
HMI region at all: the survey's only regional cuts are Ontario, BC,
Prairies (AB+SK+MB) and Atlantic Canada. Multi-family Atlantic scores
are never reported in any quarter checked -- presumed too few
respondents for the association to publish a number, not a transcription
gap on our side.

ohpa.label: Oil to Heat Pump Affordability program

chba_net_zero.label: CHBA Net Zero Home Labelling Program
chba_net_zero.note: Association-reported cumulative counts, published as a running total on CHBA's own page with its own last-updated date. Cited with attribution; CHBA publishes no data file and the underlying register is not open, so this is a citation, not a dataset. A separate CHBA page (chba.ca/net-zero/) embeds a Power BI report with a per-builder map/table (units, province, city, named contact per company) -- deliberately not used as a source: it is a business directory with personal contact details, not an aggregate figure, and sits well past the aggregates-only line this project holds for CaGBC's project database too.

chba_hmi.label: CHBA Housing Market Index
chba_hmi.note: A quarterly builder-sentiment survey, not a StatCan series: CHBA panels its own homebuilder/developer members and runs proprietary statistical analysis on their responses. Modelled on NAHB's US HMI. Scale is 0-100; 50 is neutral (share rating conditions 'Good' equals share rating 'Poor'). CHBA frames it as a leading indicator of housing starts roughly six months out. Hand-transcribed from the page's own prose, not scraped or OCR'd from its chart images -- see cited_figures_verify.py and the top-of-file comment for why.

regional.coverage_note: CHBA's only regional cuts are Ontario, British Columbia, Prairies (Alberta+Saskatchewan+Manitoba combined) and Atlantic Canada (NB+NS+PE+NL combined) -- no Quebec, no territories, no per-province detail within Prairies/Atlantic. Numeric regional scores were reported only as qualitative description (e.g. 'Ontario builders held the most downbeat views') before 2024 Q2, so this series starts there rather than backfilling a guess. null = not reported that quarter.

irregularities.issue: CHBA said only that the score 'breached the neutral sentiment mark of 50' -- no exact figure given. Recorded null rather than guessing a value from the word 'breached'.
CHBA said only 'sentiment...has held steady and is modestly positive' -- no exact figure given.
CHBA said only 'fell...to marginally pessimistic readings in the mid-40s' for both Prairies and Atlantic -- no per-region figure given.
Same 'mid-40s' phrasing as Prairies this quarter -- no per-region figure given.

CHBA reported Alberta specifically this quarter instead of the Prairies aggregate: 'Alberta's single-family HMI was 47.1'. Recorded null rather than substituting a different geography into the Prairies series.
